sources.title: Parameter Efficient Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
sources.snippet: RLHF involves two phases: reward model training, and reinforcement learning of a policy model. PE-RLHF applies parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques to optimize both of these training phases, thus significantly reducing the memory requirements, and increasing the training speed. We provide a brief overview on RLHF in Appendix A.1.
